metadata.title: NIS2 - Directive (EU) 2022/2555 on measures for a high common level of cybersecurity

controls.title: Supply chain security
controls.statement: Security related to the supply chain, including security-related aspects concerning the relationships between each entity and its direct suppliers or service providers.

controls.title: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance
controls.statement: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

controls.title: Policies to assess the effectiveness of risk-management measures
controls.statement: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.

controls.title: Access control policies and asset management
controls.statement: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management.
